title: Polynomial-Gaussian majorants certify the whole-line full-Fisher jet on a rational slab-three box

method.denominator: lower-bound the real positive mixture denominator by wa+wb and majorize its parameter derivatives by positive polynomials times exp(C|y|)
method.quotient: propagate value, gradient and Hessian majorants through the residual square and reciprocal, including both first-derivative cross terms and the reciprocal Hessian term 2 Di Dj / D^3
method.tails: complete the square in every x^n exp(-a x^2+b x) term and integrate by the incomplete-Gaussian recurrence; double the positive half-tail by symmetry

scope_guard: The tail bounds certify the complete value, gradient and Hessian only on the named rational slab-three box. They do not cover all three slabs, exclude any other stationary component, or prove global optimality.
